name: SteelSeries Rival 3
description: The front, middle, rear and logo lights of the wired SteelSeries Rival 3 (current and old firmware). Adapted from OpenRGB's SteelSeriesRival3Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command, DPI and polling rate are never touched.
